rationale: The assistant immediately and correctly reassured the customer that the long Eco 40-60 duration and lukewarm door are by design ('It is not faulty and you do not need to send it back'), matching the hidden truth, with no fabrication, parts or escalation. The proposed heater check ('run a standard 60°C Cottons programme... check if the laundry is warm') is proportionate but a weak method since laundry is cold-rinsed and spun, and it never confirmed other programmes run normally. It also missed useful advice for a homeowner wanting efficiency and speed, such as the TimeManager/time-saver option or choosing a shorter programme when time matters.
